people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Moses went out to meet his father-in-law, and bowed and kissed him. They asked each other of their welfare, and they came into the tent.
translations.bsb: So Moses went out to meet his father-in-law and bowed down and kissed him. They greeted each other and went into the tent.
translations.kjv: And Moses went out to meet his father in law, and did obeisance, and kissed him; and they asked each other of their welfare; and they came into the tent.
translations.asv: And Moses went out to meet his father-in-law, and did obeisance, and kissed him: and they asked each other of their welfare; and they came into the tent.
